stdout:
ok fresh standard starts at 6 bottles / 4 colors and keeps a confirmed queue
ok below / exactly / beyond threshold: successful action earns only due bottles
ok clear by placement earns a full normal bottle before stuck checking
ok clear by pouring unlocks immediately, but color activation waits for placement
ok crossing several thresholds pays all bottles and admits only one color per placement
ok earned bottle prevents a full-board loss in the same placement
ok failed and ended actions never consume generation or pay progression
ok new bottles accept pours, reversed pieces and normal completion scoring
ok zone settlement uses pre-unlock empties and cannot create a recursive unlock bonus
ok preview and cloned search actions do not mutate the live state
ok save / restoration replays identical state and undoes expansion without duplicate history
ok growth profile and queue policy signatures stay fixed through unlocks and isolate records
ok preview counts 0..3 restore and remain consistent across color admissions
ok table sanitization clamps colors/bottles and discards invalid or decreasing thresholds
ok tail weighting starts at the color cap and participates in the record signature
ok v1, v2 and daily transitions/signatures match the source at the baseline commit
ok same seed and policy reproduces expansion state, with colors capped after large scores
expansion engine: 17 groups passed
